reviews.title: Where’s the functionality?
reviews.text:
1) I can’t play JUST a playlist or JUST an album. I press play on a playlist or album and the next song doesn’t play on that album!! Why? 
⭐️ MOST NEEDED FEATURE⭐️: 2) I can’t quickly add songs to a playlist. I have to touch the “...” and individually add songs to a playlist rather than being able to select multiple songs to transfer to a playlist. This makes it a pain to create playlists unless you simply add an entire album to a playlist, which is the only way to add multiple songs at one time to a playlist. I noticed that you can do this at the bottom of the playlist after you scroll through your songs, but only for “recommended” music which is great, but it’s random and not mine sometimes. You should be able to scroll through your saved music and click on each song you’d like to add to a specific (or multiple) playlist without having to click “...” first. For example, I hate to compare but Apple Music has a feature where you can click “Playlist”>”Edit”>”Add Music” which then brings you to your library to add music from there OR you can search music to add that you have not yet saved or downloaded.
3) I love the idea of being able to discover new music and whatnot. Thought I’d add at least one good thing to the list. It’s a great app, but until these issues are fixed, I’m keeping it at 3 stars.

Edit: 1st issue resolved with their great tech support team! However, still only 4 stars because I can’t use the mobile app to add multiple songs at one time to a playlist. (This is only a big deal because it takes forever to create a brand new playlist).

reviews.title: Stop changing the queue!!!!!
reviews.text: Stop changing the way the queue works every single time I use this app! I swear Im this close to subscribing to apple music 👌. Just let me keep the option to play my liked songs randomly or not. Also why did I suddenly lose the option to play my liked songs based on genre?! You guys are killing me with the constant changes. Heres what the people want! To be able to play my liked songs randomly or in or order!!! I like the option sometimes! I also still want to be able to sort my liked songs by genre. Why did that suddenly go away!? I used to like the way you could channel what you want based your mood ‘like “happy”’ and whatnot but whatever, I could deal with the changes you made for whatever reason. Can you please stop changing the way liked songs work every single time I use this app!!!! Its so frustrating when I cant play my liked songs randomly all of a sudden and now I cant play my liked based on genre. FOR WHAT REASON!!!!! Stop making stupid changes all the time! You’re pushing your people to apple music, I swear. I have subscriptions to you both but I still dont want to start using them over you, but I will. All I ask for is some consistency!! I want to be able to play my liked songs by genre, and I want to be able to consistently play my liked songs randomly or in order. I dont know why you change these all the time but you are really pushing to start using apple music or even soundcloud. Keep the consistent good features, and stop changing for the worse all the time!

reviews.title: not bad music source but could be better
reviews.text: Okay, i have been using this app for a while and have experienced lots of weird things. First i want to talk about the shuffle thing. you can shuffle songs so that it picks random songs in any playlist, but thats where my huge problem is. you cant pick specific songs you just have to listen to the playlist until it plays that song. and if you have shuffle mode on for a little bit then you cant turn it off.. so, shuffle mode has a lot of disadvantages.  I cant get rid of shuffle mode so I saw another glitch. Lets say that i decided to make my own playlist, I make it and other songs are added just because of shuffle mode, but you can add songs to get rid of them. Okay, then my playlist “ends” and then RANDOM songs play.. I have to play a different playlist now. and sometimes if i return to the one that i was playing the song is still there, and if i skip it more random songs will start playing, then i have to wait a whole HOUR to get more skips. I feel like non premium users should have more freedom of doing what they want. oh, and with shuffle mode on, you cant pick a song or make it into a loop. and like i said, after a little bit you cant turn shuffle mode off. So yeah, this app could definitely improve more things. Also, please don’t take what i'm saying the wrong way. Thank you for reading, and it would be a pleasure if one of these got fixed! Byee!!❤️

reviews.title: My app is having issues
reviews.text: I’ve used this app A LOT. I remember a feature about a year ago where it showed you the lyrics on all of the songs, but it caused my app to crash every time I played a song. It would play the song halfway through and then crash and I would go back into the app and it had restarted the song. It would do this in a cycle until I skipped the song because I couldn’t handle hearing the first half of the song on repeat anymore. Occasionally it would work for one or two songs but that only happened rarely. Basically I could only hear half songs because the app kept crashing, and then I would use up all six of my skips and have to turn off the app. And I was SO relieved when after multiple months of suffering through this. Music means more to me now than it has ever, and here’s why im writing this; because I woke up this morning and saw that the lyric feature was back. I was very excited because I was hoping they had brought it back because they fixed the bugs it caused. Sadly the first song I tried to play made the app crash. I want to make you aware that I have a recent iPhone model with plenty of space on it, so it is not my phone causing these issues. Please PLEASE fix this quickly. Music is my comfort and my joy, I don’t know what I’ll do without it working. Please PLEASE PLEASE I beg you to fix this as fast as possible.

reviews.title: I love this but in the latest update…
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for the longest and I do love it. Never had any complaints. None. Until now. Hence  the reason I took down one star. It might not be a big deal to some, but to me, I used to to this every single day at least. Idk if someone can relate. In the latest update, you are listening to one playlist and when you click the green button to play and it does, but it’s just the continuation of the song you’re listening to. Meaning that, the songs that you’ve already heard say the day before, you won’t listen to them on that day because it doesn’t start from the beginning of the playlist. To do that, you have to go ahead and play another playlist, and then come back to play the desired one again to get it to start all over again. BUT you also have to make sure that you pressed the “shuffled” button bc if not, you’ll hear the songs in the order that they are and have to go back and click it. Whereas before, all you had to do was click on the green round button and it would automatically start from the beginning shuffled and all bc I always had the shuffle button on. In this update, it seems to “turn off” in idk what pattern. Maybe each day? Idk. I have diff. playlists, but most of the time I use the same one and so it’s very much annoying since it’s become more time consuming when all I really want to do is get my music going quickly and do what I gotta do. I’m not sure why they did it like this bc it also had a button to just resume your playlist as well, where you left off. I just hope they go back to the way it was when it comes to that because it’s pretty irritating:/
